baseline.source: canon: WFB 8e Dwarfs army book; WH: The Old World (2023+) Dwarfs background (King and Thanes, guilds of Engineers/Runesmiths/Miners, ancestor cult, Book of Grudges)
baseline.why: A hold is a hereditary kingdom of clan Thanes with guild masters, standing regiments, guild-controlled trade and industry, insular borders and gunpowder-plus-steam engineering (tier 3)

overrun_hold.source: canon: WFB 8e Dwarfs / Lexicanum (Karak Eight Peaks, Ekrund, Karak Varn, Mount Gunbad, Karak Ungor, Karak Vlag and Mount Silverspear are overrun, besieged or half-lost to greenskins, Skaven and Chaos)
overrun_hold.why: A besieged remnant holds the deep vaults with garrison and priests, has lost industrial capacity (one tier down) and cannot fund schools

AZL.note: Iron Hills hold; baseline unchanged (source silent on its institutions).

laws.lawgroup_navy_model.source: canon: WFB 8e Dwarfs (Barak Varr: Dwarf ironclads and gunships on the Black Gulf)
laws.lawgroup_navy_model.why: The only Dwarf hold with a real navy.

ruling_igs.source: canon: WFB 8e Dwarfs (Barak Varr is the Dwarfs' seaport and trade gate)
ruling_igs.why: Sea-traders share power with the Thanes and the guilds.

expected_government_type.why: Follows from the tag's laws at grand_principality tier.

laws.lawgroup_army_model.source: canon: WFB 8e Dwarfs (Karak Kadrin, the Slayer Keep; Slayer cult of Grimnir)
laws.lawgroup_army_model.why: The Slayer cult is the closest thing the Dwarfs have to a hereditary warrior order.

ruling_igs.source: canon: WFB 8e Dwarfs (Karak Kadrin, the Slayer Keep)
ruling_igs.why: Slayers share power with Thanes and Runesmiths instead of the guilds.

tech_tier.source: canon: WFB 8e Dwarfs (seat of the High King, foremost Engineers' Guild works, gyrocopters and organ guns)
tech_tier.why: The High King's hold is the Karaz Ankor's technological front; tier 2 reaches atmospheric_engine and mechanical_tools.
